atac_seq_alignment.description:
Align trimmed reads to a reference genome. Method neutrality: the concrete
aligner (STAR / HISAT2 / BWA-MEM2 / minimap2 / Bowtie2 / Salmon-alevin)
is selected at runtime by the agent. EDAM operation:3198 (Read mapping)
is the more-specific child of operation:0292 (Sequence alignment).

atac_seq_data_acquisition.description:
Acquire raw experimental data from public repositories (SRA, GEO, ArrayExpress,
ENA, PRIDE, ClinVar, gnomAD, GTEx) or SME-supplied paths. Emits a cohort manifest,
per-accession provenance summary, and an index pointing at the materialized
artifacts. Downstream atoms consume the manifest, not the raw bytes directly.

atac_seq_differential_accessibility.description:
Test for differential chromatin accessibility between sample groups
from ATAC-seq / CUT&RUN / CUT&Tag peak counts. DiffBind / DESeq2-on-
consensus-peaks / edgeR / csaw selected at runtime. Operates on a
consensus peak set produced by peak_calling; emits per-peak
differential statistics (log2FC, p-value, FDR).

atac_seq_discover_alignment.description: Discover method for alignment (options: star, hisat2, bwa_mem2, bwa_mem, minimap2, bowtie2). Surface set_intake_method.

spec_preferred_methods.hisat2: named in intake prose (classifier method keyword)

atac_seq_discover_differential_accessibi.description: Discover method for differential_accessibility (options: diffbind, deseq2, edger, csaw). Surface set_intake_method.

atac_seq_discover_motif_enrichment.description: Discover method for motif_enrichment (options: homer_findmotifsgenome, meme_chip, monalisa). Surface set_intake_method.

atac_seq_discover_peak_annotation.description: Discover method for peak_annotation (options: chipseeker, homer_annotatepeaks, great). Surface set_intake_method.

atac_seq_discover_peak_calling.description: Discover method for peak_calling (options: macs2, macs3, seacr, genrich). Surface set_intake_method.

spec_preferred_methods.macs2: named in intake prose (classifier method keyword)

atac_seq_discover_sequence_trimming.description: Discover method for sequence_trimming (options: trimmomatic, cutadapt, fastp, trim_galore). Surface set_intake_method.

atac_seq_motif_enrichment.description:
Identify enriched DNA-binding motifs in a peak set. HOMER
findMotifsGenome.pl / MEME-ChIP / monaLisa selected at runtime by
organism + reference. Outputs a ranked motif table (motif id, family,
p-value, fold enrichment) plus per-peak occurrence calls.

atac_seq_peak_annotation.description:
Annotate called peaks (ChIP-seq narrow / broad, ATAC-seq accessible
regions, CUT&RUN / CUT&Tag enriched intervals) to the nearest gene
and overlapping genomic feature (promoter, exon, intron, UTR,
intergenic). ChIPseeker / HOMER annotatePeaks.pl / GREAT selected at
runtime by organism + reference build. Emits a per-peak annotation
table with distance-to-TSS, nearest-gene id/symbol, and feature class.

atac_seq_peak_calling.description:
Identify regions of significant read enrichment from ChIP-seq / ATAC-seq /
CUT&RUN alignments. MACS2 / MACS3 / SEACR / Genrich selected at runtime
by mark type (narrow / broad).

atac_seq_raw_qc.description:
Run sequencing QC (FastQC, MultiQC) on raw FASTQ inputs. Emits a per-sample metric
table and aggregated report; downstream `sequence_trimming` reads the trim-needed
flag.

atac_seq_reporting.description:
Assemble narrative tables, figures, and summary text from upstream stage
outputs into a per-stage HTML / Markdown report. Modality-agnostic; bio
taxonomies override the description at the include site to specify what
goes into the report.

atac_seq_sequence_trimming.description:
Trim adapters and low-quality bases from raw reads. Conditional in legacy
taxonomies on `raw_qc.result.needs_trimming`; the atom always runs and emits
trimmed FASTQ regardless of whether it altered the inputs (idempotent on
already-clean data).

atac_seq_survey_method_landscape.description:
Retrieve a context-scoped METHOD-LANDSCAPE for this analysis: for each
runtime method-choice axis in the workflow, gather candidate methods and
PMID/DOI/URL-anchored evidence, conditioned on the specific data
(organism, protocol, sample count, missingness from the upstream QC +
sample-manifest) and the analysis goal/modality. Honors
config/downstream-policy/source-discovery-policy.json. Emit a
method_landscape.csv where every row is locator-anchored with a
substring-verified evidence_quote. No synthesis; no ranking (the
discover_* atoms rank deterministically from this table).

bulk_rnaseq_differential_expression.description:
Test for differentially expressed genes between conditions / cell types.
DESeq2 / edgeR / limma-voom / MAST / Wilcoxon selected at runtime based on
modality (bulk vs single-cell) and design.

bulk_rnaseq_discover_alignment.description: Discover method for alignment (options: star, hisat2, bwa_mem2, bwa_mem, minimap2, bowtie2). Surface set_intake_method.

bulk_rnaseq_discover_differential_expres.description: Discover method for differential_expression (options: deseq2, edger, limma_voom, mast, wilcoxon). Surface set_intake_method.

spec_preferred_methods.deseq2: named in intake prose (classifier method keyword)

bulk_rnaseq_discover_normalisation.description: Discover method for normalisation (options: deseq2_vst, edger_tmm, scran, seurat_lognormalize, sctransform). Surface set_intake_method.

bulk_rnaseq_discover_pathway_enrichment.description: Discover method for pathway_enrichment (options: fgsea, clusterprofiler, gsea, enrichr). Surface set_intake_method.

bulk_rnaseq_normalisation.description:
Standardise expression values to remove library-size and composition biases.
Method neutrality: DESeq2 VST / edgeR TMM / scran pooling / Seurat
LogNormalize / scnorm / sctransform are selected at runtime.

bulk_rnaseq_pathway_enrichment.description:
Test pre-defined gene sets (KEGG / Reactome / GO / MSigDB hallmark) against
ranked DE results. fgsea / clusterProfiler / GSEA / enrichr selected at runtime.

bulk_rnaseq_qc_preprocessing.description:
Apply count-matrix-level QC: cell or sample filtering by total counts, gene
detection, mitochondrial fraction, and doublet score. Distinct from `raw_qc`
(which operates on raw reads). ecaax:scrnaseq_cell_qc per the EDAM audit —
EDAM operation:3218 conflates raw-read QC with count-matrix QC.

bulk_rnaseq_quantification.description:
Quantify gene- or transcript-level expression from aligned reads. Method
neutrality: featureCounts / HTSeq / Salmon / kallisto / RSEM are selected
at runtime. Emits a count matrix consumed by downstream normalisation.

taxonomies override the description at the include site to specify what
goes into the report.

variant_calling_review_prior_work.description:
Retrieve prior literature (PMC OA full-text XML by default, broader via
ECAA_LIT_SOURCE_SCOPE) on the analysis's target entities + tissue +
modality. Emit a structured prior_claims_matrix.csv where every row is
PMID-anchored with a substring-verified evidence_quote. No biological
synthesis, no narrative review.

variant_calling_sequence_trimming.description:
Trim adapters and low-quality bases from raw reads. Conditional in legacy
taxonomies on `raw_qc.result.needs_trimming`; the atom always runs and emits
trimmed FASTQ regardless of whether it altered the inputs (idempotent on
already-clean data).

variant_calling_survey_method_landscape.description:
Retrieve a context-scoped METHOD-LANDSCAPE for this analysis: for each
runtime method-choice axis in the workflow, gather candidate methods and
PMID/DOI/URL-anchored evidence, conditioned on the specific data
(organism, protocol, sample count, missingness from the upstream QC +
sample-manifest) and the analysis goal/modality. Honors
config/downstream-policy/source-discovery-policy.json. Emit a
method_landscape.csv where every row is locator-anchored with a
substring-verified evidence_quote. No synthesis; no ranking (the
discover_* atoms rank deterministically from this table).

variant_calling_validate_alignment.description:
Validate outputs of: Align trimmed reads to a reference genome. Method neutrality: the concrete
aligner (STAR / HISAT2 / BWA-MEM2 / minimap2 / Bowtie2 / Salmon-alevin)
is selected at runtime by the agent. EDAM operation:3198 (Read mapping)
is the more-specific child of operation:0292 (Sequence alignment).

variant_calling_validate_contextualize_f.description:
Validate outputs of: Map each row of the upstream findings table (DE genes / called peaks /
called variants) to PMID-anchored prior-work rows. Emit
claims_evidence_matrix.csv with deterministic concordance flags
(same_direction / opposite_direction / no_prior_finding / unverifiable).
No synthesis; no narrative.

variant_calling_validate_data_acquisitio.description:
Validate outputs of: Acquire raw experimental data from public repositories (SRA, GEO, ArrayExpress,
ENA, PRIDE, ClinVar, gnomAD, GTEx) or SME-supplied paths. Emits a cohort manifest,
per-accession provenance summary, and an index pointing at the materialized
artifacts. Downstream atoms consume the manifest, not the raw bytes directly.

variant_calling_validate_final_reporting.description:
Validate outputs of: Assemble the project-level final report: cross-stage narrative, dashboard
index, key figures, methods + caveats. Final node before SME review.

variant_calling_validate_raw_qc.description:
Validate outputs of: Run sequencing QC (FastQC, MultiQC) on raw FASTQ inputs. Emits a per-sample metric
table and aggregated report; downstream `sequence_trimming` reads the trim-needed
flag.
